- R2 (no over-normalization): a condition with `childId="${PLAIN_ID}"` (a plain entry) — `targetChildId` is unchanged.
- R3 (edges, one case each, no crash): `childId="model"` (type keyword, no definition behind it) stays `'model'`; `childId="any"` is already read as `null` by the reader and stays `null`; a condition with no `childId` attribute at all stays null/undefined.

- R5 (the rule is not restricted to root links): a condition with `childId="${NESTED_LINK_ID}"` — `targetChildId` becomes NESTED_TARGET_ID.

WHAT — block 2, the behaviour, a miniature of the pin (level: integration through the public facade; `evaluate(prepareDataset({ catalogues: [xml] }), roster)`). Build a second catalogue XML that mirrors the pinned mechanism and nothing else: a `forceEntry` FORCE_ID; a root `entryLink` TOGGLE_LINK_ID → TOGGLE_TARGET_ID with NO constraints of its own (so no mandatory phantom clouds the result); a `sharedSelectionEntries` entry TOGGLE_TARGET_ID (type `upgrade`, no constraints); and a root `selectionEntry` HERO_ID (type `unit`) carrying `constraint id=MAX_ID type=max value=0 field=selections scope=force shared=true includeChildSelections=false` plus `modifier type=set value=1 field=${MAX_ID}` gated by `condition type=atLeast value=1 field=selections scope=force childId=${TOGGLE_LINK_ID} shared=true includeChildSelections=true`.
